title: Scorecard
description:
Producer-side contract for `--format scorecard-row` output emitted by the crap-rs adapters (crap4rs, crap4ts).

A scorecard is a top-level artifact aggregating one or more `Row` entries. Each crap-rs adapter is a *producer* that emits a single `Row::CrapDelta` JSON object on stdout per run — aggregators (any downstream CI or PR-comment tooling) compose those rows into the scorecard envelope.

This schema fragment is owned by the crap-rs repository and ships as the contract any consumer can validate emitted rows against. Schema versioning is producer-driven: a bump signals an additive or breaking change in what crap-rs adapters can emit. Aggregator-side row variants (coverage, mutation, BDD, dependency-graph etc.) are out of scope here — they belong to whichever tool produces them.

schema_version.description: Producer-contract version. Bumps when crap-rs adds, renames, or alters a `Row` variant or changes a required field on an existing variant. Aggregators MUST check this on ingest and refuse unknown versions rather than silently degrading.

rows.description: Heterogeneous list of scorecard rows. Today crap-rs emits exactly one row per run (`Row::CrapDelta`); the array shape is preserved so aggregators can compose multiple producers' outputs into a single envelope without re-keying.

Row.description: Tagged union of row variants. The `type` discriminator selects the variant; additional crap-rs row variants land here as the producer surface grows. Variants produced by other tools (coverage / mutation / BDD aggregators, etc.) are not enumerated — those tools own their own variants and ship them in their own schema extensions.

CrapDelta.description: CRAP delta — count of functions over the configured CRAP threshold, minus the same count on the baseline. Producer is `crap4rs` / `crap4ts` (the `--format scorecard-row` projector).

id.description: Stable row id (e.g. `"crap_delta"`). Aggregators use this for anchor links.

anchor.description: URL-fragment anchor for the rendered row (e.g. `"crap-delta"`).

status.description: Producer-minted verdict. Set by the projector — callers cannot supply this directly.

threshold.description: CRAP threshold in effect on this run. Surfaced so downstream tooling can interpret `delta_count` without out-of-band knowledge of the producer's configuration.

delta_count.description: Signed delta vs. baseline (positive = new violations landed; negative = violations decreased). When run without a baseline, equals the current over-threshold count.

delta_text.description: Producer-rendered display string (e.g. `"5 → 7 (+2)"`). Aggregators surface this verbatim and never reparse.

failure_detail_md.description: Markdown describing the new violations. Required when `status == "Red"` (enforced by the `if/then` clause above); omitted otherwise.

Status.description: Per-row verdict. String-tagged so JSON Schema post-processors can match against `{ "const": "Red" }` to enforce variant-specific requirements (e.g. CrapDelta's `failure_detail_md` on Red).
